name: ClimSim
size_as_stated: 124 numerical features, output of size 128 (extracted rain rate); 4,000 training points for target non-heavy rain, target heavy rain nT varying up to 250, source heavy rain nS up to 2,500, test set around 2,000 heavy rain and 4,000 non-heavy rain

scales.note: ClimSim multi-scale dataset based on E3SM-MMF; spatial resolution (~110 km), 20-minute output interval, 10-year run (~45 TB) estimated from standard ClimSim specifications.
